title.rendered: Jody and Seth Gay Wedding DJ First Unitarian Universalist Society San Francisco

content.rendered:
﻿Jody and Seth Gay Wedding DJ First Unitarian Universalist Society San Francisco

November 30th San Francisco Wedding DJ
Here are ideas/requests for your consideration:
3:00 – Starr King Room and Chapel are open to us to begin set-up
5:00 – 6:00 Family Dinner which you are included to eat – soft background classical
6:00-6:25 Chapel while guests are being seated – classic wedding songs Ava Maria for example, Bach, etc. We have a friend that will be playing the piano for the processional and recessional songs.
6:30 wedding ceremony begins. Perhaps for a few minutes as guests are departing one or two classical songs or more upbeat happy songs.

7:30 – Reception begins – soft background music for first 15 minutes while people are visiting/socializing (Seth and I will probably be relaxing a few moments in private room/signing marriage license with pastor from 7:30 to 7:45.

7:45 – Wedding party introduction including the grooms Songs: During: WWE “Let’s Get Ready to Rumble” and After: Stevie Wonder “Signed Sealed Delivered I’m Your’s. Then we cut the cake to: Archies “Sugar Sugar”. We have no preference for serving each other a champagne.

8:00 ish depending how on schedule we are running is “First Dance” we previously discussed via email: 1945 Harry James – All of My Life by Irving Berlin.

We put down a bunch of songs that we like and then ranked them and came up with a Top Ten list that we really would like to have played at your discretion sometime through the evening and are as follows in no particular order:

Sister Sledge “We Are Family”
Village People “YMCA”
Kenny Chesney “She Thinks My Tractor’s Sexy”
Weather Girls “It’s Raining Men”
Andrew Sisters “Boogie Woogie Bugle Boy of Company B”
Scissor Sisters “I Don’t Feel Like Dancing”
Cool and the Gang “Celebration”
Surfaris “Wipe Out”
B-52’s “Private Idaho”
Blondie “Call Me”

The Following Songs were really tough for us to cut and not be in our top ten and are backups for your consideration:

Sylvester “You Make Me Feel (Mighty Real)”
GoGo’s “We Got The Beat”
Salt N Pepa “Push It”
Chubby Checker “Twist”
Glenn Miller “In The Mood”
Pink “Let’s Get This Party Started”
Toni Basil “Mickey”
Abba “Does Your Mother Know”
K.C. & The Sunshine Band “Get Down Tonight”
The Knack “My Sharona”
Madonna “Into The Groove”

Other songs for your consideration include:

Van McCoy “The Hustle”
A Taste of Honey “Boogie Oogie Oogie”
Bee Gees “You Should Be Dancing”
Devo “Whip It”
Martha and the Vandellas “Dancing in the Street”
Bananarama “Venus”
Dead or Alive “You Spin Me Round”

DJ & Led Uplighting Package
